questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Upon reaction with $\mathrm{CH}_{3} \mathrm{MgBr}$ followed by protonation, the compound that produces ethanol is
questions.solution:
\(\mathrm{CH}_{3} \mathrm{CHO}+\mathrm{CH}_{3} \mathrm{MgBr} \rightarrow \mathrm{CH}_{3} \mathrm{CH}(\mathrm{OH}) \mathrm{CH}_{3}\)
\(\mathrm{HCHO}+\mathrm{CH}_{3} \mathrm{MgBr} \rightarrow \mathrm{CH}_{3} \mathrm{CH}_{2} \mathrm{OH}\)
\(\mathrm{HCOOH}+\mathrm{CH}_{3} \mathrm{MgBr} \rightarrow \mathrm{CH}_{4}\)
So \(\mathrm{HCHO}\) on reaction with \(\mathrm{CH}_{3} \mathrm{MgBr}\) followed by protonation will produce ethanol.

questions.q: Reaction of phenol with <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>NaOH</mi></math> followed by heating with <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>CO</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> under high pressure, and subsequent acidification gives compound <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">X</mi></math> as the major product, which can be purified by steam distillation. When reacted with acetic anhydride in the presence of a trace amount of conc. <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><msub><mi>SO</mi><mn>4</mn></msub><mo> </mo><mo>,</mo></math> compound <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">X</mi></math> produces <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">Y</mi></math> as the major product. Compound <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">Y</mi></math> is
questions.solution: Reaction of phenol with NaOH followed by heating with CO2 under high pressure and subsequent acidification gives salicyclic acid X as the major product, which can be purified by steam distillation. When reacted with acetic anhydride in presence of a trace amount of conc. H2SO4, compound X produces methyl salicyclate Y as the major product.
